correctness.rationale: A legal alternating-square switch swaps the columns of exactly two rows and must avoid the two forbidden diagonal matches; filtering the swapped permutations against the complete derangement set implements precisely this adjacency. Conjugation preserves adjacency, so one source of every cycle type suffices for eccentricity, not a quotient path. Independent lexicographic enumeration, sorted-key swap membership and sparse unweighted shortest paths covered all retained vertices, all switches and every cycle type for n=4 through 9. The degree-sum check Σ[binom(n,2)−n+c₂(π)] corroborated the edge totals. All six order/size/radius/diameter rows and all eight full nine-symbol profiles matched both frozen outputs. The only distance-ten shell has size one, on type (3,3,3), and its vertex is the inverse. Inversion is a fixed-point-free involution on those 2240 sources, giving 1120 pairs. The small-order per-type rows in the repair match the complete C++ recorded profiles; the finite radii and diameters are also independently reproduced. All n from four through eight have diameter at most n and the known ninth case has diameter ten, proving exactly the repaired least-size claim.
residual_risks: This is an exhaustive finite computation and proves no distance formula for n>9. The nine-symbol output alone would not establish a first occurrence without the smaller searches.
